profile.headline: Engineering Lead
profile.summary: Senior software engineer and engineering leader with 15+ years of experience building mission-critical systems and the teams behind them. I've led distributed, cross-functional teams through growth and reorganization while staying hands-on with architecture, system design, and delivery. I'm at my best when bridging the gap between people and technology - translating real problems into the right solutions through trust, clarity, and honest communication.

positions.title: Engineering Lead
positions.description: Led a distributed, intercontinental engineering team of 6, owning hiring of multiple engineers, performance reviews, promotions, career development, and team culture through two major reorganizations. Partnered with Product and QA leadership on OKRs and roadmap planning while remaining hands-on with architecture, system design, technical standards, and production code contribution.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Served as Technical Lead across multiple high-priority projects, coordinating cross-functional delivery and acting as the primary escalation point for production reliability. Facilitated architectural workshops, drove observability and incident response practices, and mentored junior engineers toward promotion.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built and refactored business-critical APIs, data pipelines, and event-driven systems, directly protecting significant revenue and reducing operational costs. Drove process improvements across engineering and product while contributing to platform modernization and cross-team knowledge sharing.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Led full-stack development as sole engineer of the flagship product, serving as both the primary technical contributor and the client-facing technical contact for enterprise customers. Wore many hats as primary product engineer, customer service, and support engineer. Introduced process improvements and infrastructure modernization that streamlined onboarding, deployment, and delivery.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Customer Service · LAMP stack · Docker
